The first release of AbyssDB. Infinitely fast. Perfectly consistent. Zero-knowledge.

Version `0.0.0-null` contains everything we have built so far and keeps every byte of it.

## Highlights

- **ACID, BASE and all three letters of CAP**, simultaneously, [formally proven](https://abyssdb.xyz/paper/).
- **PostgreSQL-compatible.** `psql`, `pgbench`, `pgx` and ORMs connect unmodified. `pgbench -i` loads ten million accounts in 27.8 s, every row validated and sealed under its own key.
- **Faster than PostgreSQL** on real TPC-B: 36,545 tps against 125 for PostgreSQL 18 with its default settings (Linux, prepared, 8 clients).
- **Schema-yes or schema-less.** Strictly validated tables, and a key-value store for JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, Morse code and AbyssQL values.
- **Post-quantum everything.** ML-KEM-768 key establishment, a unique key per row, an AES-256-GCM → ChaCha20-Poly1305 cascade at rest, ML-DSA-65 signatures and `X25519MLKEM768` TLS.
- **Distributed.** NullRaft consensus, two-phase commit with NullTime™ commit-wait, and interplanetary replication to `mars-olympus-1`.
- **AI-native.** An MCP server, agent memory and AbyssGPT.
- **Runs everywhere.** Linux, macOS, Windows, WASI and [your browser](https://abyssdb.xyz/playground/).

## Install

Download the archive for your platform below, or:

```
docker run -p 5432:5432 ghcr.io/noctarius/abyssdb:0.0.0-null
go install github.com/noctarius/abyssdb/cmd/abyssdb@v0.0.0-null
```

Then connect with any PostgreSQL client:

```
psql -h localhost -U you abyss
```

Verify downloads against `checksums.txt` (SHA-256).

## Upgrading

This is the first release. There is nothing to migrate, and nothing will be.
